elements.justification: 'Park' applies DEF-NRS-484A-155: 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of merchandise or passengers'. drv.motion.parked denotes 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration'; 'A halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out, is not denoted', which carries the definition's exclusion of a temporary halt for loading. Same mapping as the index's 'It shall be unlawful for any person to park' (LVMC_11_40_170).

'vehicle' is admitted as the aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate is 'membership of a legal aggregate'. It is not a relational role (who drives) and no class atom replaces an admitted aggregate.

'Access aisle' applies DEF-LVMC-11-02-030: an area 'Adjacent to a parking space designated for the handicapped' and 'Marked by spaced, crosshatched or diagonal stripes'. st.parking_space is a 'marked bay for standing or parking; designation in {general, disabled, disabled_side_lift, access_aisle, municipal, charging}': the designation access_aisle is the marked aisle beside a disabled bay. 'in' places the vehicle there: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', anchors the vehicle to the aisle it is in, not to any aisle of the scene.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and its footprint overlaps a parking-space region whose designation is access_aisle (st.parking_space, rel.occupies) at the observation.
obligation: The subject is not parked (drv.motion.parked with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance and min_duration p.parking_min_duration) while its footprint overlaps that access-aisle region: for every parking-space region of designation access_aisle the subject occupies at the observation, the subject is not parked there.

narrowings.why: 'No person shall park' is read through the vehicle's own standing; whoever or whatever controls it, the duty binds the vehicle's conduct.

The definition's exclusion of a halt made 'temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading' is read through the halt's duration: a halt shorter than p.parking_min_duration is the temporary halt and is not parking; the loading purpose itself is not observed.

The defined area's design for 'unobstructed ingress, egress and access' and its adjacency to a disabled bay are read through the mapped marking: a parking-space region the source designates access_aisle is the access aisle.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car (vehicle aggregate) comes to rest with its footprint overlapping a st.parking_space of designation access_aisle beside a disabled bay and stays at rest there (kin.speed at or below the tolerance) for longer than p.parking_min_duration.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car halts briefly in an access-aisle parking space, shorter than p.parking_min_duration, to let a passenger out, then drives off; drv.motion.parked never holds while it occupies the aisle.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car parks for a long time in a parking space of designation general; its footprint never overlaps an access_aisle region.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car stands at rest next to an access-aisle region for longer than p.parking_min_duration; the source does not observe rel.occupies, so whether it is in the aisle is unknown.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition source's kinematic channel

param_proposals.name: p.parking_min_duration
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as temporary, as for loading or unloading: a common time limit of a passenger loading zone
param_proposals.source: municipal curbside management practice: passenger loading zone time limits
